candidates.change_summary: Changed the assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing unlockTime to be set in the past or lowered.
Removed the line that updates acc.balance, so deposits no longer increase stored balance (affects future observable behavior of Put/Collect).
Changed acc.balance update to subtract msg.value instead of adding it, decreasing stored balance on Put.
Inserted a require that msg.value must be at least MinSum, rejecting smaller deposits and changing observable outcome of Put.
Reordered statements: moved LogFile.AddMessage to before updating acc.balance, so event logging occurs with old balance effects (observable order change in logs).
Change the withdraw condition to require block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime instead of >, allowing collection exactly at unlock time.
Remove the MinSum check so callers can collect amounts even when account balance is below MinSum.
Swap external call and balance update order to send funds before decreasing acc.balance (introducing potential reentrancy effects).
